programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights

programme.title: A Body In The Basement
programme.desc: In 2017, an Ohio couple finds a dismembered body in a basement freezer. It unlocks a harrowing mystery surrounding a missing woman and a tragic love triangle.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath
programme.desc: An Orlando, Florida, man fakes psychosis to avoid responsibility for killing his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath
programme.desc: A Burlington Township, New Jersey, man kills his girlfriend, but he reveals she is not his first victim.
